types.label: Adaptive Hierarchy
types.roles: one readable UI/body family; introduce display or mono roles only when the content, object, or workflow earns them
types.ceiling: restrained title until the real content establishes reading distance and hierarchy
types.check: real copy, mixed language, user text scaling, truncation, and the first mobile breakpoints

types.label: System Utility
types.roles: one reliable UI/body family, weight and spacing carry hierarchy, tabular numbers where alignment matters
types.ceiling: compact title; display type off by default
types.check: real labels, mixed language, user text scaling, dense rows

types.label: Humanist UI
types.roles: humanist UI/body family with open counters and comfortable short-copy rhythm
types.ceiling: moderate headings; avoid decorative display faces in controls
types.check: small sizes, long labels, CJK/Latin mixing, error copy

types.label: UI Sans + Restrained Mono
types.roles: readable UI sans plus mono only for code, ids, shortcuts, or machine state
types.ceiling: compact title; mono is not a substitute for hierarchy
types.check: code wrapping, tabular values, keyboard hints, CJK labels

types.label: Editorial Pair
types.roles: body/UI face plus a restrained editorial face for earned titles only
types.ceiling: display is allowed only when copy and media carry a narrative job
types.check: mobile line breaks, captions, navigation, dense metadata

types.label: Technical Display
types.roles: stable UI face with a narrow or technical display role for object/state labels
types.ceiling: display role stays local to the object, not the whole interface
types.check: viewing distance, contrast, touch targets, fallback state
